introHtml: Screen printing on stationery delivers bold, durable logos that stand up to daily use in offices and field operations. Unlike digital printing, screen print ink sits on the surface for vibrant color payoff on papers, cardstocks, and poly covers. It is an excellent choice for bulk orders of notepads, spiral notebooks, and presentation folders where consistent, opaque branding matters. Marketing directors and HR teams often select screen print stationery for company handbooks, training kits, and promotional mailers that require a professional, long-lasting finish.
